items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: O'Neal was a good piano player.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah, yeah, he was a good piano player. O'Neal was a good piano player. And also there was another piano player, oh he played nice piano too, and he was playing in the district during the time when ... Did you ever hear Tony Jackson? Oh, Tony Jackson. He was good. Yeah, I heard Tony Jackson, Louis Wade, Fred Washington, and I'm trying to think of this other piano player. I heard them all three playing in a house at one time, you know, one take time. Yeah. And he was a very good piano player. And then the…
Some people have told me he was a wonderful pianist, and others say well he was mostly a good singer and entertainer. Was he a wonderful pianist?
